title: CHED seeks trust fund account amid possibility of travel tax abolition, lawmaker says

blocks.text: The Commission on Higher Education (CHED) is seeking the creation of a trust fund account with the Bureau of Treasury (BTr) amid the possibility of the abolition of travel tax, according to the Department of Finance’s budget sponsor, Lanao del Sur 1st District Representative Zia Alonto Adiong.
